snippet.title: Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen - Main Trailer
snippet.description:
Your unwritten epic begins.

Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen enriches the dynamic fantasy world and expansive adventures of Dragon's Dogma 2 with unforgettable new tales and thrilling encounters.

Available for the first time, the Nintendo Switch 2 version will contain both the Dragon's Dogma 2 base game and the Dark Arisen Expansion content.

The Dark Arisen Expansion will also be available as separate DLC on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Steam.

■Platforms: Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation®5, Xbox Series X|S, Steam
■Release date: October 9, 2026
■Official X: https://x.com/DragonsDogma
■Official website: https://www.dragonsdogma.com/2da
